description: Permanently remove a page link. Ask for confirmation before calling; requires confirm: true. On a published page the change is saved as a draft and the public page keeps its approved version until the person approves publishing; then pass confirm_publish: true. Requires API key scope: draft.

confirm_publish.description: true only after the person explicitly approved publishing; without it, changes to a published page wait as a draft.

name: page_link_remove
title: Remove page link
